Even though I had the presence of mind to film the delivery driver driving off with the item, and my video doorbell recorded our exchange, in which I clearly tell the delivery driver that I’m refusing the delivery.

The name of the transporter is YunExpress and if you go in trustpilot reviews you will see that it's not rare to get this type of issues. Their rate review is today at 1.3/5

![Rated 4 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-4.svg)

[**Solid Compact Treadmill/Walking Pad**](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a8f2792c7eb29ebbe5b13a5)

Payment and Shipping was easy and fast. I needed a way to get steps in after surgery without having to go out in the extreme heat of my location. After a lot of research, I bought the Strol 2E Pro Smart Treadmill and the Foldable Treadmill Mat. I wanted a more compact treadmill that had wheels for easy moving and storage under the couch. I also wanted a treadmill that could elevate, had handles, and would allow for jogging speeds. I have used it almost every day for about a month and am happy with the purchase. It is convenient and functioning well. The manual incline and bar set up is a little tedious because of the screws- not difficult, but when you want to store it after every use, it can be a bit of a hassle to repeat. I have not tried jogging, yet, but I can tell already I wouldn't mind the treadmill being a little longer. I did buy it for the compactness, though, so I knew what I was getting. Walking is fine if I keep towards the front (I'm 5'5"), but something to consider if you are taller and want to jog.

The treadmill is one of the lighter ones I found, which is great because it doesn't feel cheap, but storage under the couch is more difficult than anticipated. There are only small wheels on the very front, almost flush with the rest of the machine, so after you hit a certain angle sliding the treadmill under the couch, you are no longer on the wheel. I put it on some furniture pads, which made it a bit easier. Definitely cannot easily slide the treadmill parallel (lengthwise) under the couch, because there are no wheels on the side. You have to go in from the front of the treadmill.

I put the treadmill on the pad to protect my floor, and my one complaint here is that the front screwed-in support stands have already created holes in the pad, so maybe opt for a higher quality pad.

All in all, very pleased with my purchase
